misprints.note: The genitive ending is printed with an acute and no breathing. That matches the book's usual way of printing endings, so it may not be an error at all.
The genitive is printed in shortened form as 'γγός'. I kept it as printed.
The print has a comma before the colon. I kept it.
The print has an acute on εἴς before the enclitic τι. That is correct accentuation, so I'm only noting it.
